name: Visegrad Scholarship Program
country: Czechia / Hungary / Poland / Slovakia (also EaP/WB hosts for V4 citizens)

tags: V4 / Eastern Partnership / Western Balkans citizens
note: Master's or post-master's (doctoral/postdoc) study or research stay in another V4 country (or, for V4 citizens, in an EaP/WB country); citizenship must differ from the host country.

name: National Scholarship Programme of the Slovak Republic – Study Stays for Students

tags: Not for full-degree students in Slovakia
note: For bachelor's and master's students enrolled abroad doing a 1–2 semester stay at a Slovak university; two deadlines a year (30 April, 31 October).

name: Slovenian Scholarships for Western Balkans Citizens (Master's Study in Slovenia)
